exposure: embryo reduction with local methotrexate injection
outcome: resolution of caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
cohort: 30 patients diagnosed with caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP) at Shatby Maternity University Hospital, Egypt.
finding: The appropriate CSEP management strategy varies according to gestational age, and suction and embryo reduction with local methotrexate injection offers an effective, safe and minimally invasive surgical treatment.
gest_age: Varied, influencing treatment strategy (specific ranges not provided).
